description: This file is a shell test script for Git functionality related to 'parallel-checkout' with various attributes such as re-encoding, end-of-line conversions, external filters, and delayed processing. It runs multiple test cases to verify the correctness of parallel checkout operations under different configurations.

methods.name: set_checkout_config
methods.description: Sets configuration parameters for the checkout process, including parallelism and other options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_cmp_bin
methods.description: Compares binary contents of files to expected values.

methods.name: test_checkout_workers
methods.description: Executes the checkout operation with specified worker count and command.

methods.name: verify_checkout
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of the checkout operation.
